customers.grain: One order-linked customer record per customer_id; customer_unique_id can repeat.

customer_id.description: Order-linked customer identifier; orders join on this field.

customer_unique_id.description: Cross-order customer identifier; not a unique row key.

customer_zip_code_prefix.description: Source ZIP prefix as text; no automatic padding.

geolocation.grain: One source geolocation observation; ZIP prefixes and entire rows may repeat.

geolocation_zip_code_prefix.description: Source ZIP prefix; not a unique join key.

order_status.description: Source lifecycle status, not an inferred completion flag.

order_estimated_delivery_date.description: Estimated delivery date; not an actual event.

order_items.grain: One order item, identified by (order_id, order_item_id).

order_item_id.description: Item sequence within the order, not a global identifier.

price.description: Source item price in BRL; not profit or platform revenue.

freight_value.description: Source item freight value in BRL.

order_payments.grain: One payment component per (order_id, payment_sequential); orders may have many.

payment_sequential.description: Payment component sequence within the order.

payment_type.description: Source payment method, including not_defined if supplied.

payment_installments.description: Source installment count; zero is retained and flagged.

payment_value.description: Source payment component amount in BRL.

order_reviews.grain: One source review record; neither review_id nor order_id is assumed unique.

review_id.description: Source review identifier; uniqueness is profiled, not assumed.

order_id.description: Reference to orders.order_id; multiple reviews are retained.

review_score.description: Review score on the source 1–5 scale.

review_comment_title.description: Optional source review title; text is preserved.

review_comment_message.description: Optional source review text; text is preserved.

product_category_name.description: Portuguese source category; may lack translation.

product_name_lenght.description: Source name length; original misspelled column retained.

product_description_lenght.description: Source description length; original name retained.

product_weight_g.description: Source weight in grams; null/zero retained.

seller_zip_code_prefix.description: Source ZIP prefix as text; no automatic padding.

category_translation.grain: One translation per Portuguese category name; source coverage is not assumed complete.

product_category_name.description: Portuguese source category; translation lookup key.
